_about: Approved English wording for site queries (WS4, task D11): non-leading, data-completeness requests to site staff, the coded responses a site can give, and the phrases no query text may contain. Frozen with the sap-v1 tag; after the tag any change needs a row in docs/11 section 17. Rendered by backend/app/services/site_queries.py; a CRA approves every query before it reaches the site. Placeholders are limited to site_id, episode_lines, subject_id, term, episode_date and grade: subject IDs only, never names. Rules: docs/02-data-model.md (SiteQuery) and docs/10-site-signal.md sections 6.4 and 7.3.
